title: Every status/watch/overview call leaks refs/ticfac/peek/runscan refs
description:
mwt's epic-of-run resolution fetches all of origin's epic/* branches into refs/ticfac/peek/runscan/<pid>-<n>/ and never deletes them. The main checkout already holds 55 such refs, about 11 more per bare ticfac, status or watch call that resolves an unhinted run_* id. This sits on top of an older leak of the same kind (refs/ticfac/peek/status). It also puts a network fetch on the overview's cheap path. Fix: delete the refs after the read, or read the remote-tracking refs without a fetch.
evidence: internal/cli/epic_of_run.go:84-87; git for-each-ref refs/ticfac/peek/runscan | wc -l

ticfac run epic-hn6 filed this backlog tick from the finding c1d7d55ea4617441068249ce131083eacf6ce7a1b89819e7c714b6465e1e77ae (reported by run-epic-hn6/tick-pv7/attempt-42): the done is reachable with the finding standing, so it is a backlog tick with an owner rather than the epic's to absorb. The decision record is .ticfac/runs/epic-hn6/absorptions/c1d7d55ea4617441068249ce131083eacf6ce7a1b89819e7c714b6465e1e77ae.json on the run branch.
